name: Shoulder
description: The shoulder joint is a ball and socket joint between the scapula and the humerus. It is the most mobile joint in the human body.
function: Allows flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, rotation, and circumduction of the arm.
clinical_information: Commonly prone to dislocation and rotator cuff injuries.

name: Shoulder
description: The shoulder joint is a ball and socket joint between the scapula and the humerus. It is the most mobile joint in the human body.
function: Allows flexion, extension, abduction, adduction, rotation, and circumduction of the arm.
clinical_information: Commonly prone to dislocation and rotator cuff injuries.

name: Thorax (Chest)
description: The region of the body between the neck and the abdomen. Contains vital organs such as the heart and lungs.
function: Protects vital organs and assists in respiration.
clinical_information: Area examined for cardiovascular and respiratory conditions.

name: Nose
description: The protuberance in vertebrates that houses the nostrils, which receive and expel air for respiration.

name: Forehead
description: The bony part of the head above the eyes, formed by the frontal bone.
function: Protects the frontal lobe of the brain.
clinical_information: Site of frontalis muscle. Common area for Botox injections.

name: Left Eye
description: Organ of visual system. Complex structure including cornea, iris, lens, retina and optic nerve.
clinical_information: Susceptible to conjunctivitis, glaucoma, and cataract.

name: Right Eye
description: Organ of visual system. Complex structure including cornea, iris, lens, retina and optic nerve.
clinical_information: Susceptible to conjunctivitis, glaucoma, and cataract.

name: Mouth
description: The opening through which food and air enter the body. Contains teeth, tongue, and salivary glands.
clinical_information: Common site for ulcers, infections, and dental disease.

name: Chin
description: The protruding part of the face below the mouth, formed by the apex of the lower jaw (mandible).
function: Aids in chewing and jaw movement.
clinical_information: Commonly fractured in falls. Prominent mentalis muscle attachment site.
